records.source_definition_paraphrase: Opening that attracts attention and points toward the position.
records.source_unit: character span within a school essay; not a paragraph
records.condition: It must prepare this reader for the argument; introduction position alone does not establish orientation.
records.counterexample: A generic attention-grabber can fail to orient.

records.counterexample: An objection is not automatically a qualification accepted by the author.
